definitions.explanation: So terrible or extreme as to be frightening or shocking. Used to describe scenes, situations, or experiences of extreme severity.
Of extraordinary intensity or ferocity, often describing battles, competition, or struggles that push beyond normal limits.

examples.japanese: {凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧だった。
⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A horrific reality spread across the battlefield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The appalling conditions of the disaster area were reported on television.

examples.japanese: {凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was an extremely fierce battle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凄絶|せいぜつ}な{打|う}ち{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Both fighters showed an intensely fierce exchange of blows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{闘|たたか}い→闘い：17305_tatakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めなかった→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: He continued a desperate fight against the disease and never gave up until the very end.

notes:
USAGE:
{凄絶|せいぜつ} is a literary and dramatic word used primarily in written language, journalism, and formal speech. It conveys a sense of something that goes beyond ordinary severity — shocking or awe-inspiring in its intensity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧ (an extremely fierce battle)
- {凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ (a ghastly sight)
- {凄絶|せいぜつ}な⟦{最期|さいご}→最期：30329_saigo⟧ (a gruesome/fierce end)
- {凄絶|せいぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to reach the height of horror/intensity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{壮絶|そうぜつ}→壮絶：12092_souzetsu⟧: heroically fierce, intense (similar but with a more positive, admiring nuance)
- ⟦{悲惨|ひさん}→悲惨：12633_hisan⟧: tragic, miserable
- {凄|すさ}まじい: terrible, tremendous (more colloquial)
